title: feat(studio): the Records tab keeps Add field on screen, a header click opens the field, the name field leads, the inspector puts the label first
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBA6p6wR5XRGmnECFZqr87FM)_

Fixes #34794
Clause-②: yes (widening) — an optional `columnMenuLabel` member on the exported `GridFieldAuthoring` context type of `@object-ui/components`, and new keys in the lazy `studio` namespace of `@object-ui/i18n`; nothing that worked before is refused
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 数据栏「记录」页。工具栏左端常驻「添加字段」（右侧属性栏打开时也看得到）。点列头 = 选中该字段并打开属性，不再排序；排序和隐藏放进每个列头的小箭头菜单（就是右键那个菜单）。名称字段排第一列并冻结，「负责人」挪到业务字段之后。对象标题旁不再挂内部名，悬停标题可见。字段属性面板：显示名在最上，API 名称收进默认折叠的「开发者信息」；删除从面板底部移到顶部「···」菜单，删除前弹确认框。
- 为什么改：#34794 的 6 项（维护者「都是p1」）。日常改字段不该先面对内部名；1280 宽下打开属性栏后「+」列被挤出屏外；点列头误触排序。
- 风险与回滚：只动控制台前端（app-shell 的 Studio 数据栏和字段属性面板；components 的表格多一个可选成员；i18n 只加 studio 懒加载命名空间的键）。运行时列表不受影响：不提供该成员的表格，列头 HTML 逐字节不变（有测试钉住）。不动元数据、契约、服务端。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`（列头捕获点击选中字段的那段，以及 `gridColumnsComputed` 里 `leadWithNameField` 排序那段）、`ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`（`FieldMoreMenu` 与 `DeveloperSection`）、`data-table.tsx`（`columnMenuLabel` 小箭头按钮）。
- 两分钟验证：本地起 CRM，Studio 新建一个对象并加几个字段，打开「记录」页：工具栏最左是「添加字段」；点任一字段列头，右侧打开该字段属性、行顺序不变；点列头小箭头出现「升序排列 / 降序排列 / 隐藏列」；属性面板第一个输入框是显示名，「开发者信息」展开后才见 API 名称；「···」→ 删除会先弹确认。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地

## What changes

Studio Data pillar, Records tab (`ui/packages/app-shell`):

1. **Add field is always on screen.** A new `StudioGridAddFieldButton` sits at the start of the records grid's own toolbar row (`ListView`'s `toolbarLeading`). It opens the same `AddFieldPopover`, with the pillar's own `addField`, taken names and extension mode. It draws only when the grid's field-authoring context carries `onAddColumn`, which is exactly when `canAddFields` holds, so the toolbar entry and the kept trailing "+" column cannot disagree.
2. **A header click opens the field.** The records body takes a click on a field's column header in the capture phase, the Interfaces canvas's `ColumnHeaderSelect` pattern, and selects that field (its properties open; the header is outlined). It does not sort. Controls inside the header keep their own click. A column the author's buffer does not declare (the injected `owner_id`) keeps the grid's click. Sort and hide are one click away: the host sets the new `columnMenuLabel`, and every header draws a caret that opens the table's existing column menu (the right-click menu).
3. **The name field leads.** `gridColumnsComputed` now orders the columns through the shared `leadWithNameField` (ADR-0079 D4) over the author's fields, then the served-only columns. The name field is the frozen first column (ObjectGrid's default `frozenColumns`). `owner_id` follows the business fields. Only the Studio grid's columns change; runtime list views are not touched.
4. **The machine name is a tooltip.** The Data header passes `titleProps.title` (the object's name) instead of `apiName`, so the mono chip beside the title is gone.

Field inspector (`ObjectFieldInspector`):

5. **Label first.** The display-name box is the first control. The API name moved into a "Developer info" section (`DeveloperSection`), collapsed by default, with a one-line hint. The body is `hidden`, not unmounted, so its state and the inspector's existing readers keep working.
6. **Delete is behind ⋯ and confirmed.** The footer Remove button is gone. A `FieldMoreMenu` at the end of the header actions holds "Remove FIELD", which opens an `AlertDialog` (title, body, Cancel, Delete) before `removeField` runs. The trigger is disabled on a locked inspector (display-patch or read-only), and there is no menu on an external object, matching the old footer exactly.

`@object-ui/components`: `GridFieldAuthoring.columnMenuLabel` (optional). When set, `data-table` draws a caret in every column header, named by the value, that toggles the table's own column menu. The caret's click never reaches the header (no sort). Without a provider, or without the member, the header is unchanged.

`@object-ui/i18n` (lazy `studio` namespace only, en + zh): `designer.field.section.developer`, `designer.field.section.developerHint`, `designer.field.removeConfirmTitle`, `designer.field.removeConfirmBody`, `engine.studio.data.columnMenu`.

Changeset: `.changeset/34794-studio-records-tab-authoring.md`, patch for `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/components`.

### Before / after (live, 1280×800, zh-CN, CRM fresh boot)

| Acceptance line | Before (origin/main c513d62) | After (this branch) |
|---|---|---|
| Add field reachable with the pane open | only the trailing "+" column, at x=1559 in a 680-wide scroller (scrollWidth 1347): off screen | toolbar "添加字段" at x=256 in the toolbar's leading slot; click opens the popover (label input visible); "+" column kept |
| Header click | sorted the rows | opens the field's properties (label box = 会议地点), rows unchanged |
| Sort / hide | right-click only, no visible entry | caret on every header opens 升序排列 / 降序排列 / 隐藏列; 升序 reorders the rows, 隐藏列 removes the column |
| Column order | `#`, owner_id 负责人 (frozen), name, … | name 名称 (sticky), 会议日期, 会议地点, 主持人, 参会人, 会议纪要, 备注, owner_id 负责人 |
| Inspector order | API 名称 above 显示名 | first control is the label box; API name hidden until 开发者信息 is opened, then editable |
| Delete | footer 删除“X”, no confirmation (0 dialogs) | no footer button; ··· → 删除“会议地点” → dialog 删除字段“会议地点”？… 取消 / 删除; Cancel keeps the column, Delete removes it |
| Object title | mono chip with the machine name | h1 text 会议, `title` = huiyi_jiyao_meeting, no chip |

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/__tests__/data-table-header-column-menu-34794.test.tsx` (4): no provider or no member ⇒ header HTML byte-identical to a plain table, and with the member the carets are the only added nodes; the caret's name, `aria-expanded`, menu entries, toggle, no sort on caret click; the menu sorts desc, asc, and hides; the header's own click still sorts.
- New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/DataPillar.recordsTab-34794.test.tsx` (6, real grid): column order and sticky name column; toolbar Add field in `list-toolbar-leading` that creates a field; read-only rail draws neither entry; header click opens the inspector without sorting, caret menu has 3 entries; the served `owner_id` header selects nothing; title tooltip, no chip.
- `ObjectFieldInspector.test.tsx` (shared harness) gains 4 cases: order and collapse; rename from the opened section and the taken-name refusal; ⋯ → Remove → dialog, Cancel keeps / Delete removes; read-only ⇒ trigger disabled, external ⇒ no menu.
- Existing suites updated for the moved controls: `DataPillar.authoredBuffer-29793` (new column order), `DataPillar.celGate`, `DataPillar.readOnlyRailReason-12303`, `ObjectFieldInspector.displayPatchReason-28986`, `external-object`, `StudioItemHeader.statusPlace-12524`, `StudioDesignSurface.heldDataCreate-26845` / `heldDataLeave-26705` / `heldFlowCreate-26845` (title tooltip in place of the chip). Edited suites that reach a dynamic `@objectstack/lint` / `@objectstack/formula` load now pay it at collection (`check:test-source-alias`).

## Acceptance notes

- The caret mirrors the right-click menu, so it is drawn on every column the menu is offered on, the actions column included.
- On the CRM package and `com.objectstack.platform-objects` (code packages, `writable: false`), both Add field entries are offered, because the pillar authors an extension there (`canAddFields` with `extendsBase`, already true of the "+" column). On `com.objectstack.setup` neither is drawn. The toolbar entry agrees with the "+" column in all three.
- Deleting a published field that holds rows is refused by the server's draft save (409 `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE`), and the pillar shows its existing "更改未保存" banner. This change only adds the confirmation before `removeField`; it does not change what the save sends.
- The column order comes from `leadWithNameField`, so an object that declares no name field keeps its declared order with the served-only columns after it.
- PR #34851 (#34725) also adds an optional `GridFieldAuthoring` member and touches `data-table.tsx`; overlap-check merges both cleanly.
